highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.1 corrects GPU geometry, clip recording and displacement-filter precision without changing managed APIs.

bullets.detail: Corrects ellipse and rounded-rectangle axis mapping and clamps transformed corner radii to prevent overlap. Empty Ganesh flushes no longer leave stale atlas tokens. Graphite accounts for unrecorded clips and warns and skips draws whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass.

Displacement offsets now use float precision to match filter bounds. Native synchronous Vulkan submission incorporates fence-wait failure while preserving timeout retries and asynchronous behavior; GRContext.Submit remains void and gains no managed failure result or exception.

v4.156.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.1 improves transformed GPU shapes, clip recording and displacement-filter precision.
v4.156.1.body: It also corrects stale atlas bookkeeping after empty flushes and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling. Managed APIs are unchanged.
